description: AI jobs & skills metric search — PwC AI Jobs Barometer. Filtered search over the Ni Biashara AI jobs & skills shelf: the headline metrics of PwC's 2025 Global AI Jobs Barometer (close to a billion job ads analysed) as structured records — value, comparison baseline, period, scope and the finding as published. Filter by text, theme (wages, productivity, revenue, jobs, skills, hiring demand) or scope (global, US). $0.25 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

limit.description: max records to return (optional, default 25, max 60)

q.description: free text over the metric label, finding and measured group (optional)

theme.description: metric theme: wages, productivity, revenue, jobs, skills or hiring_demand (optional)
